evidence.quote: Section 41001(6)(A) of the FAST Act (42 U.S.C. 4370m(6)(A)) is amended

summary.short: Amends paragraph (6)(A) of Section 41001 of the FAST Act to add semiconductors, artificial intelligence and machine learning, high-performance computing, advanced computer hardware and software, quantum information science, data storage and management, and cybersecurity to a list of project types. Approved August 16, 2022.
summary.long: This Act has one operative section. Section 1 amends paragraph (6)(A) of Section 41001 of the FAST Act (42 U.S.C. 4370m(6)(A)), in the matter preceding clause (i), by inserting after 'manufacturing' a list of computer-related fields: semiconductors, artificial intelligence and machine learning, high-performance computing and advanced computer hardware and software, quantum information science and technology, data storage and data management, and cybersecurity. The title states that the purpose is to include these computer-related projects in the Federal permitting program under title XLI of the FAST Act. The text does not contain separate obligations, thresholds, enforcement provisions or definitions. The Act was approved August 16, 2022.
